tools.name: findLocalOffice
tools.description: Find the Fenix Begravningsbyrå page for a Swedish town or city, returning the local page URL and, where Fenix has a local office, its street address and phone number. Use when the user names a place.

city.description: Swedish town, city or municipality name, for example "Norrköping", "Uppsala" or "Skinnskatteberg". Spelling does not have to be exact.

tools.name: getChecklistSteps
tools.description: List the practical steps to take in the first days after a death in Sweden, in order, with a link to the full guide. Use when the user asks what to do when someone has died or what needs to be arranged.

tools.name: getContactOptions
tools.description: Get the ways to reach Fenix Begravningsbyrå from this page: the phone number currently shown to this visitor, the tel: link, the booking page and staffed hours. Use before telling the user how to contact us.

tools.name: getPackagePrices
tools.description: Get Fenix Begravningsbyrå's fixed package prices in SEK for funerals and family law services. Use when the user asks what a funeral, cremation or legal service costs. Prices are the same across Sweden; a null price means the price is quoted individually.

category.description: Which prices: "funeral" for packages with their contents, "legal" for legal services, or "all" for both. Defaults to "all".

tools.name: listServices
tools.description: List the funeral and legal services Fenix Begravningsbyrå offers, each with a page URL. Use to answer what the company can help with, or to find the right page for a service.

category.description: Which services to list: "funeral" for funeral services, "legal" for estate and family law services, or "all" for both. Defaults to "all".

tools.name: openBookingForm
tools.description: Open the "Boka rådgivning" dialog so the user can book a free advisory call, optionally pre-filling what they have already told you. Opens and fills only: the user must review, pass the spam check and submit it themselves, so never tell them a booking has been made.

first_name.description: The user's first name, if they have already provided it.

last_name.description: The user's surname, if they have already provided it.

phone.description: The user's Swedish phone number, if they have already provided it.

service_type.description: What the user needs help with: "funeral" if someone has died, "legal" for estate or family law advice. Defaults to "funeral".

tools.name: searchSite
tools.description: Search fenixbegravning.se for guides, services, products, places and local pages. Use when no more specific tool covers the question.
